data.body:
## 做了什么

当一个 issue 的某个 PR **既被 review 过、又已合入默认分支**时，在 issue 行（以及对应 PR 行）标题旁显示一个 ✨ 徽章，表示“这是走完整条流水线的成果”。

判定条件（必须同一个 PR 同时满足）：

- `pr.state === 'MERGED'`；
- 且 `pr.review.lastReviewedSha` 非空（调度器的 review-and-improve 至少完成过一次）。

只 merged 未 review、只 review 未 merged 都不点亮。issue 有多个 PR 时，只要有一个满足即点亮，并在提示里指明是哪个 PR。

## 改动

- **`public/spark-badge.js`（新增）**：`CCSpark` 纯函数模块（`isReviewedAndMerged` / `prSparkView` / `issueSparkView`），浏览器用全局、测试用 `module.exports`。issue 行和 PR 行共用同一判定，不可能出现分歧；只读现有 payload，不发任何 GitHub 请求，不改调度/合并逻辑。
- **`lib/store.js`**：`getStatuses` 的 PR 负载补上 `review: { lastReviewedSha }`（只加字段，不改语义）——徽章完全由该负载在前端决定。
- **`public/index.html`**：引入脚本、新增 `.spark` 样式、issue 行与 PR 行渲染徽章。未点亮时用隐藏占位（`display: inline-block; visibility: hidden`）保持行内对齐，沿用 `.wfsync` 空位的做法；`mergePrs` 保留 `review`，避免一次没带该字段的刷新把已点亮的徽章抹掉。
- **`test/spark.test.js`（新增）**、**`test/store.test.js`**：覆盖 merged+reviewed、只 merged、只 review、`state: null` 旧记录、多 PR、空数组、null/异常输入，以及负载字段本身。
- **`README.md`**：新增“✨ Reviewed-and-merged badge”一节并更新目录树。

`title` / `aria-label` 例：`Reviewed and merged into main (PR #123, reviewed at abc1234)`。

## 验证

- `npm test` 全绿（46 passed）。
- 在 8000 端口起服务，用浏览器实测 `renderIssue`：merged+reviewed 点亮且 hover 文案正确；只 merged / 只 review / 无 PR 均不点亮；隐藏占位的 computed style 为 `inline-block` + `visibility: hidden`（对齐不变）。

Closes #68

---

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

## What this does

When an issue has a PR that was **both reviewed and merged into the default branch**, a ✨ badge is shown next to the issue row title (and the PR row that earned it), marking it as a fully-vetted result.

Both conditions must hold for the same PR:

- `pr.state === 'MERGED'`;
- and `pr.review.lastReviewedSha` is non-empty (the scheduler's review-and-improve pass completed at least once).

Merged-but-never-reviewed and reviewed-but-not-merged both stay dark. If an issue has several PRs, any one qualifying lights the badge, and the tooltip names that PR.

## Changes

- **`public/spark-badge.js` (new)**: `CCSpark` pure-function module (`isReviewedAndMerged` / `prSparkView` / `issueSparkView`), exposed as a global in the browser and via `module.exports` for tests. Issue row and PR row share one decision so they can never disagree; it reads only existing payload data — no GitHub request, no change to scheduling/merge logic.
- **`lib/store.js`**: `getStatuses` PR payload now includes `review: { lastReviewedSha }` (field addition only, no semantic change) — the badge is decided in the browser from this payload alone.
- **`public/index.html`**: script include, `.spark` styling, badge rendering on both rows. When not lit it renders an invisible placeholder (`display: inline-block; visibility: hidden`) to keep row alignment, the same approach the `.wfsync` slot already uses; `mergePrs` now preserves `review` so a refresh that doesn't carry it can't blank an earned badge.
- **`test/spark.test.js` (new)** and **`test/store.test.js`**: cover merged+reviewed, merged-only, reviewed-only, legacy `state: null` records, multiple PRs, empty arrays, null/garbage input, and the payload field itself.
- **`README.md`**: new "✨ Reviewed-and-merged badge" section plus the file-tree entry.

Example `title` / `aria-label`: `Reviewed and merged into main (PR #123, reviewed at abc1234)`.

## Verification

- `npm test` passes (46 tests).
- Ran the app on port 8000 and drove `renderIssue` in a real browser: merged+reviewed lights up with the correct hover text; merged-only / reviewed-only / no-PR stay dark; the hidden placeholder computes to `inline-block` + `visibility: hidden`, so alignment is unchanged.

</details>

## 变更

修复 #21：移动端打开 🔔 Alerts / ⏩ Depth 抽屉时，头部被浮动顶部导航药丸（z-index 60）遮挡。

- `.settings-drawer` / `.depth-drawer` 的 `z-index` 由 41 提升到 70，`.depth-scrim` 由 40 提升到 69，抽屉与遮罩层现在始终绘制在 `.navbar` 之上。
- 两个抽屉改为 flex 纵向布局：`.drawer-head` 粘性置顶，内边距为 `calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px))`，避开 iOS 状态栏；`.drawer-body` 可滚动，底部内边距为 `calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))`，避开 home indicator。长内容不再把标题挤出屏幕。
- 每个抽屉头部新增可见的 ✕ 关闭按钮；新增 `Esc` 键关闭；点击遮罩层关闭的行为保持不变。
- 抽屉加上 `role="dialog"` / `aria-modal` / `aria-label`，开关时同步 `aria-hidden`。

## 验证

在 390×844（iPhone）视口下用 Playwright 验证：

- 「🔔 Task alerts」标题与提示文字完整可见，无遮挡。
- `document.elementFromPoint()` 在导航药丸位置返回 `drawer-head` / `depth-scrim`，确认导航不再压在抽屉之上。
- ✕、遮罩层点击、`Esc` 三种方式都能关闭两个抽屉。
- `npm test` 全部通过（10/10）。

Closes #21

---

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

## Changes

Fixes #21: on mobile, the 🔔 Alerts / ⏩ Depth drawer headers were painted under the floating top nav pill (z-index 60).

- Raised `.settings-drawer` / `.depth-drawer` `z-index` from 41 to 70 and `.depth-scrim` from 40 to 69, so the drawer and its scrim always paint above `.navbar`.
- Both drawers are now flex columns: a sticky `.drawer-head` padded with `calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px))` clears the iOS status bar, and a scrollable `.drawer-body` padded with `calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))` clears the home indicator. Long content can no longer push the title off screen.
- Added a visible ✕ close button to each drawer header plus `Esc` to close; tapping the scrim still works.
- Added `role="dialog"` / `aria-modal` / `aria-label` and keep `aria-hidden` in sync on open/close.

## Verification

Verified with Playwright at a 390×844 (iPhone) viewport:

- The "🔔 Task alerts" title and hint render fully with nothing overlapping.
- `document.elementFromPoint()` at the nav pill position returns `drawer-head` / `depth-scrim`, confirming the nav no longer paints over the drawer.
- ✕, scrim tap and `Esc` all close both drawers.
- `npm test` passes (10/10).

Closes #21

</details>

## 变更内容

让 TestFlight 页面展示该应用可获取的全部历史 Build，每次 Deploy 尝试都是独立记录。

- **`lib/buildHistory.js`（新增）**：纯函数模块，把 store 中每个 PR 的 `deploy` 与 `deployHistory` 扁平化成 build 列表；提供稳定 id、时长、失败原因提取与排序，并在单条记录损坏时把错误收集到 `errors` 而不是整体失败。
- **`lib/store.js`**：`deploy` 新增 `branch` / `commit` 字段（含迁移回填），`listAllBuilds()` 改为返回 `{ builds, errors }` 并复用新模块。
- **`server.js`**：Deploy 启动时把该次构建的分支与提交固定写入记录（PR 后续新增提交也不会改写历史）；`/api/testflight/builds` 逐条容错，返回 `{ builds, errors, total, generatedAt }`。
- **前端（`public/index.html`）**：新增版本 / 状态 / 日期 / 应用筛选与「清除筛选」、历史条数统计；卡片增加分支、提交（可点击）、开始与结束时间、耗时、issue、PR 状态、退出码、失败原因与 `attempt n/m · superseded` 徽章；部分记录读取失败显示横幅，整体加载失败显示重试按钮，单条渲染异常降级为一张错误卡片。
- **`test/buildHistory.test.js`（新增）**：覆盖多次构建保留、同版本区分、idle 不计入、失败原因提取、分支/提交回退、部分失败容错等。
- **README**：新增「TestFlight tab — full build history」章节与 API 表条目。

## 验收标准

- [x] TestFlight 页面能看到过去全部可获取的 Build。
- [x] 每条记录展示版本、Build 号、时间、状态和可用元数据（分支/提交/PR/issue/耗时/What to Test）。
- [x] 同一版本的多个 Build 均可区分并保留。
- [x] 筛选和刷新不会丢失历史记录（筛选只是对完整内存列表的视图，刷新重新读取完整历史）。
- [x] 单条或部分数据失败时，其他历史 Build 仍正常显示。

## 验证

- `node --test test/*.test.js` → 18 passed。
- 本地以 mock `state.json` 启动服务（端口 8000），浏览器验证：两条同版本 Build 均展示、筛选计数正确、清除筛选恢复全部、加载失败出现 Retry 且重试成功。

Closes #60

---

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

## What changed

The TestFlight page now lists every build ever recorded, one row per deploy attempt.

- **`lib/buildHistory.js` (new)**: pure module flattening each PR's `deploy` + `deployHistory` into build entries, with stable ids, durations, failure-reason extraction and sorting; a corrupt entry is reported in `errors` instead of failing the listing.
- **`lib/store.js`**: `deploy` gains `branch` / `commit` (with migration backfill); `listAllBuilds()` now returns `{ builds, errors }` and delegates to the new module.
- **`server.js`**: pins the branch + commit actually shipped when a deploy starts, so history stays accurate after the PR moves on; `/api/testflight/builds` isolates per-row failures and returns `{ builds, errors, total, generatedAt }`.
- **Frontend**: version / status / date / app filters plus "Clear filters" and a history count; cards show branch, commit (linked), start & finish times, duration, issue, PR state, exit code, failure reason and an `attempt n/m · superseded` badge; a warning banner for partially unreadable records, a Retry button on load failure, and a per-card fallback when one build cannot render.
- **`test/buildHistory.test.js` (new)**: covers history retention, same-version distinction, idle exclusion, failure reasons, branch/commit fallback and partial-failure isolation.
- **README**: new "TestFlight tab — full build history" section and API table row.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] All obtainable past builds are visible.
- [x] Each row shows version, build number, time, status and available metadata.
- [x] Multiple builds of the same version stay distinct and preserved.
- [x] Filtering and refreshing never lose history.
- [x] A failing entry does not hide the rest.

## Verification

- `node --test test/*.test.js` → 18 passed.
- Ran the server locally on port 8000 with a mock `state.json` and verified in the browser: both same-version builds listed, filter counts correct, clearing filters restores all rows, load failure shows Retry and retrying succeeds.

Closes #60

</details>

data.body:
Closes #64

## 做了什么

让 cloud-copilot 从「一个仓库同时只能跑一个 PR 任务」变成「多个 PR 任务真正并行」，并为 committed issue 加上一个会自己干活的调度器。

### 1. 并发 worktree + 端口池

- **每次运行一个一次性 worktree**（`lib/worktreePool.js`）：租借 `<repo>/.worktrees/<action>-<issue>-<hex>`，通过 `.git/info/exclude` 排除，不会污染工作区。Create PR 拿到 `origin/<base>` 的 detached 检出；分支类操作检出 PR 分支，或复用已经持有该分支的既有 worktree。
- **每个 worktree 一个端口**（`lib/portPool.js`）：从 **8000–8888** 中真实 bind 探测后发放，注入为 `PORT` / `CC_TEST_PORT`，两个任务各自起服务不会打架；服务器自己的端口永远不会被发放。
- **状态隔离**：同时注入 `CC_DATA_DIR=<worktree>/.cc-data`，worktree 内的嵌套运行不可能写到真实的 `data/state.json`。
- **上限与排队**：每仓库 3 个、全局 6 个（`CC_MAX_WORKTREES*`），超出时 FIFO 排队而不是直接失败。
- **绝不丢工作**：释放复用既有的 disposability 判定——只有干净且可证明没有未推送提交时才会删除，其它一律留在磁盘上；启动时清扫崩溃残留。
- **Deploy / Merge / Restart main 仍然互斥**，它们确实需要仓库主工作区。前后端旧的「一个仓库只能跑一个 Create PR」互斥锁已移除。

### 2. ⚡ 运行任务面板

首页左上角新增 ⚡ 按钮，带正在运行任务数的角标。展开后逐行显示：仓库 + issue、正在做什么、已运行时长、占用的 worktree 与端口、是手动还是自动触发、issue 链接，以及每行一个 **Stop**。面板打开时每 3 秒刷新，底部是调度器开关和「立即巡检」。

### 3. committed issue

每个 issue 新增一个 committed 勾选框，状态写入 GitHub 的 **`committed` 标签**——标签本身就是状态，可在 GitHub 上直接查看和修改，本地重置也不会丢。

### 4. 调度器

每 10 分钟（`SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_MS`）巡检一次，对每个 committed issue 做当前优先级最高的事：

1. **Create PR**——没有开着的 PR 时。创建前会重新向 GitHub 核对，人工开的 PR 会被接管而不是重复创建。
2. **从 base 同步**——PR 落后于 base 分支时，这就是「始终跟最新 main 保持同步且可用」的实现。
3. **Review 并改进**——每个 head commit 只做一次；新的推送让它重新变得 eligible。已 review 的 SHA 从 git 读取（而不是每小时才刷新的 PR 缓存），所以不会被自己的推送触发死循环。

仓库之间并行、仓库内部串行；**人永远优先**——某个仓库有人工任务在跑，本轮整仓跳过。失败指数退避，3 次后标记 `needsAttention` 并不再重试。自动运行就是普通任务：出现在 ⚡ 面板里、写进同一份日志、发同样的 ntfy 推送（标题前缀 `自动 ·`）。开关默认关闭且**持久化**，重启后恢复并在创建前重新核对 GitHub，服务器重启不会产生重复 PR。

## 验证

无自动化测试仓库，按既有方式验证：

- `node --check server.js`，全部模块可正常 require。
- 同一仓库上**同时发起两个 Create PR**：两个任务分别拿到 `port=8000 / 8001` 与各自的 worktree，取消后 worktree 与端口全部回收，`git worktree list` 干净。
- 给 issue 打上 committed 后开启调度器并立即巡检：日志出现 `[scheduler] cloud-copilot#61: review`，自动任务以 `auto: true` 出现在 `/api/jobs` 中并占用独立端口；取消后同样干净回收。
- 浏览器验证 ⚡ 面板、调度器开关、committed 勾选框渲染正常，控制台 0 错误。

## 新增环境变量

`CC_MAX_WORKTREES_PER_REPO`(3)、`CC_MAX_WORKTREES`(6)、`CC_PORT_RANGE_START`(8000)、`CC_PORT_RANGE_END`(8888)、`CC_COMMITTED_LABEL`(committed)、`SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_MS`(600000)、`CC_DATA_DIR`。

---

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

Closes #64

## What this does

Turns cloud-copilot from "one PR task per repo at a time" into truly parallel PR tasks, and adds a scheduler that drives committed issues on its own.

### 1. Concurrent worktrees + port pool

- **One throwaway worktree per run** (`lib/worktreePool.js`): leases `<repo>/.worktrees/<action>-<issue>-<hex>`, excluded through `.git/info/exclude` so nothing lands in your diff. Create PR gets a detached checkout of `origin/<base>`; branch actions check out the PR branch or reuse an existing linked worktree that already holds it.
- **One port per worktree** (`lib/portPool.js`): handed out of **8000–8888** after a real bind probe and exported as `PORT` / `CC_TEST_PORT`, so two runs can boot servers side by side. The server's own port is never leased.
- **Isolated state**: each lease also sets `CC_DATA_DIR=<worktree>/.cc-data`, so a nested run inside a worktree can never scribble on the real `data/state.json`.
- **Limits and queueing**: 3 per repo, 6 globally (`CC_MAX_WORKTREES*`); beyond that runs wait in a FIFO queue instead of failing.
- **Never lose work**: release reuses the existing disposability check — a worktree is only removed when it is clean and provably has no unpushed commits; anything else is left on disk. Crash leftovers are swept at startup.
- **Deploy / Merge / Restart main stay mutually exclusive** because they genuinely need the repo's real checkout. The old per-repo Create PR lock is gone from both server and client.

### 2. ⚡ Running tasks panel

A new ⚡ button in the top-left, badged with the number of running jobs. It lists repo + issue, what is running, elapsed time, the worktree and port it holds, whether it was started manually or automatically, a link to the issue, and a **Stop** button per row. It polls every 3 seconds while open; the scheduler switch and "Run a sweep now" live at the bottom.

### 3. Committed issues

Every issue gets a committed checkbox that writes the **`committed` GitHub label** — the label *is* the state, so it is visible and editable on GitHub and survives any local reset.

### 4. Scheduler

Every 10 minutes (`SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_MS`) it sweeps and, for each committed issue, does the highest-priority thing that is due:

1. **Create PR** when the issue has no open PR — re-checked live against GitHub first, so a hand-made PR is adopted rather than duplicated.
2. **Update from base** when the PR is behind — this is what keeps every committed PR continuously in sync with the newest `main`.
3. **Review & improve**, once per head commit; a new push makes the PR eligible again. The reviewed SHA is read from git rather than from the hourly PR cache, so a review can never loop on its own push.

Repos run in parallel, tasks within a repo serially, and **humans always win**: a repo with any manually started job is skipped for that sweep. Failures back off exponentially and after 3 attempts the record is flagged `needsAttention`. Automatic runs are ordinary jobs — visible in the ⚡ panel, streamed to the same log, with the same ntfy push (title prefixed `自动 ·`). The switch is off by default, **persisted**, restored on restart, and re-verified against GitHub before creating anything, so a bounce never produces a duplicate PR.

## Verification

The repo has no test suite; validated the existing way:

- `node --check server.js`; every module requires cleanly.
- **Two Create PR runs started at once on the same repo**: they took `port=8000 / 8001` and separate worktrees; after cancelling, both worktrees and ports were reclaimed and `git worktree list` was clean.
- Labelled an issue committed, enabled the scheduler and swept: the log showed `[scheduler] cloud-copilot#61: review`, the automatic job appeared in `/api/jobs` with `auto: true` on its own port, and cleaned up on cancel.
- Browser check of the ⚡ panel, scheduler switch and committed checkbox: renders correctly, 0 console errors.

## New env vars

`CC_MAX_WORKTREES_PER_REPO`(3), `CC_MAX_WORKTREES`(6), `CC_PORT_RANGE_START`(8000), `CC_PORT_RANGE_END`(8888), `CC_COMMITTED_LABEL`(committed), `SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_MS`(600000), `CC_DATA_DIR`.

</details>

data.body:
## 背景

PR workflow 行此前看不出分支相对 base 的新旧程度：一个 PR 可能已经落后 `main` 几十个提交，或者已经存在冲突，只有点进 GitHub 才能发现。等到点 Merge 时才被拦下，反馈太晚。

## 本次改动

### 1. 同步状态徽标（workflow 行最左侧）

每个 open PR 在 workflow 行的最左侧显示与 base 分支的同步状态：

| 徽标 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `⇣N` | 落后 base N 个提交（可合并） |
| `⚠` | 与 base 存在冲突 |
| `✓` | 已同步（弱化显示，不抢视线） |
| `?` | 状态未知（fork PR、接口失败等，**绝不伪装成已同步**） |
| `⟳` / `!` | 正在更新 / 上次更新失败 |

已合并（MERGED）的 PR 不显示徽标，但保留占位以保证各行对齐。

### 2. 点击徽标 → Copilot 更新分支

点击徽标会弹出确认框，然后开启一个**新的 Copilot 会话**，在 PR 的 head 分支上执行 `main → PR head` 方向的合并、解决冲突、验证并推送。

方向安全：提示词明确禁止 `gh pr merge`、禁止 force push、禁止新建 PR；确认框也写明「这不会把 PR 合并进 base」。

成功与否由 git 判定而非 transcript：任务结束后服务端执行 `git rev-list --count origin/<head>..origin/<base>`，只有退出码为 0 **且** 落后数为 0 才算成功。GitHub 的 `mergeable` 字段是异步计算的，不能直接信任。

### 3. 数据获取按仓库批量进行

`lib/gh.js` 新增 `listPrSync(ownerRepo)`：一次 GraphQL 拿全部 open PR 的元数据，再用一次带别名的 `Ref.compare` 查询拿到全部 ahead/behind，**不会按 PR 逐个请求**。结果进 L2 缓存（`prSync`），随 `syncRepoFromGitHub` 与 `/prs` 一起刷新。跨仓库（fork）与含特殊字符的分支名会被跳过并记为 `unknown`。

### 4. 与现有基础设施复用

- 新增 `update` action，纳入 per-repo 工作树锁（与 create/merge/deploy 互斥）
- SSE 实时日志面板、Abort、刷新页面后自动重连
- 结束后统一走 `worktrees.cleanupAfterRun`
- 成功后 `resetForNewCommits` 归档旧 Deploy 并重新锁上 Merge
- 通知渠道加上 `update` 的中英文标签

## 验收验证

- `listPrSync` 对本仓库 13 个 open PR 的真实返回值已核对（冲突/落后/已同步均正确）
- 用 `COPILOT_BIN=/bin/echo` 跑通两条路径：clean PR → `success`；落后 25 且冲突的 PR → `failed` 并给出「still 25 commit(s) behind」，证明成功不是由退出码伪造的
- 浏览器实测徽标渲染、禁用态、MERGED 隐藏与行对齐

Closes #58

---

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

## Background

The PR workflow row gave no hint about how stale a branch was relative to its base. A PR could be dozens of commits behind `main`, or already conflicting, and you would only find out by opening GitHub — or by being blocked at Merge time, which is far too late.

## What this change does

### 1. Sync badge (leftmost lead area of the workflow row)

Every open PR shows its sync state against the base branch:

| Badge | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `⇣N` | N commits behind base (mergeable) |
| `⚠` | Conflicts with base |
| `✓` | In sync (deliberately subtle) |
| `?` | Unknown (fork PR, API failure, …) — **never faked as clean** |
| `⟳` / `!` | Updating / last update failed |

MERGED PRs hide the badge but keep its slot so rows stay aligned.

### 2. Clicking the badge launches a Copilot update session

Clicking asks for confirmation, then starts a **new Copilot session** that merges `main → PR head` on the PR's own branch, resolves conflicts, verifies, and pushes.

Direction safety: the prompt explicitly forbids `gh pr merge`, force-pushing, and opening a new PR; the confirm dialog states that this does NOT merge the PR into its base.

Success is decided by git, not by the transcript: after the job the server runs `git rev-list --count origin/<head>..origin/<base>`, and success requires exit code 0 **and** a behind-count of 0. GitHub's `mergeable` field is computed asynchronously and cannot be trusted directly.

### 3. Data is collected per repo, in batches

`lib/gh.js` gains `listPrSync(ownerRepo)`: one GraphQL call for all open-PR metadata, then one aliased `Ref.compare` query for all ahead/behind numbers — **never one request per PR**. Results go into the L2 cache (`prSync`) and refresh together with `syncRepoFromGitHub` and `/prs`. Cross-repository (fork) PRs and branch names with unsafe characters are skipped and recorded as `unknown`.

### 4. Reuses existing infrastructure

- New `update` action, covered by the per-repo working-tree lock (mutually exclusive with create/merge/deploy)
- SSE live log panel, Abort, and automatic reconnect after a page reload
- Always runs `worktrees.cleanupAfterRun` when finished
- On success, `resetForNewCommits` archives the old Deploy and re-locks Merge
- Notification channels gain bilingual labels for `update`

## Verification

- `listPrSync` was checked against the 13 real open PRs of this repo (conflicting / behind / clean all correct)
- Both job paths exercised with `COPILOT_BIN=/bin/echo`: a clean PR → `success`; a PR 25 behind and conflicting → `failed` with "still 25 commit(s) behind", proving success is not faked from the exit code
- Browser-verified badge rendering, disabled states, MERGED hiding, and row alignment

Closes #58

</details>

data.body:
Closes #61

## 问题

内存里的 `jobs` 表和持久化的 `data/state.json` 会失去同步。服务一重启（Deploy 的 `npm run cc:restart`、Restart main、手动重启都算）子进程全没了、job 表清空，但存储里仍是 `working` / `deploying` / `merging`。此时 `cancel` 只查内存 job，查不到就返回 `{cancelled:false}` 并且不碰存储——行永远卡在运行中，仓库工作树锁不释放，同仓库其他 issue 一直显示 `Waiting — another PR creation is running in this repo…`。前端又完全忽略 cancel 的响应，所以点 Abort 连个提示都没有。

## 改动

**server.js** — 新增 `abortAction(repo, issue, action, prNumber?)`，三个 cancel 路由（work / deploy / merge）统一走它：
- 有活 job → `jobs.cancelJob()` 照旧杀进程（终态仍由 job 自己的 `close` 写入，避免双写）；
- 没有活 job → 调用 `store.forceAbort()` 把存储状态收敛为 `aborted`；
- 返回 `{ cancelled, reconciled, aborted }`，让前端能区分「杀掉了进程」和「清掉了幽灵」。

启动时新增一次 `store.reconcileOrphanedJobs()`，与已有的 admin turn 恢复并列，并打印收敛数量。

**lib/store.js** — 新增：
- `forceAbort(repo, issue, action, prNumber)`：仅当记录仍处于该动作的运行态时才改为 `aborted`，写入 `finishedAt`、重算 `durationMs`，并在 transcript 末尾追加一行说明。幂等，返回是否真的改动过。
- `reconcileOrphanedJobs(isRunning)`：扫描全部记录，跳过 `isRunning(key)` 为真的（永不误伤活 job），其余运行态一律收敛。

**public/index.html** — 三个 abort handler 读取响应并交给新的 `afterAbort()`：被收敛时打印 `[… 已不在运行 — 卡住的行已清除]` 并立刻触发 `reconcile*` 重绘；`aborted:false` 时说明「没有可中止的任务」。另外给 `reconcileWork/Deploy/Merge` 加了按 tag 的去重守卫——页面加载时已经在轮询、Abort 又触发一次会打印两条 `finished` 并发两次通知。

## 验证

在真实卡住的数据上验证（issue #58 的 Create PR、ios-diet-expert #87 的 Deploy #105）：

- 幽灵记录点 cancel：`{"cancelled":false,"reconciled":true,"aborted":true}`，再点一次 `{"cancelled":false,"reconciled":false,"aborted":false}`（幂等）。
- 重启服务：启动日志 `Marked 1 interrupted job(s) as aborted: cloud-copilot#58:work`，状态变 `aborted`，`activeWorkIssues` 变空。
- 浏览器实测：`Deploying…` 行点 ⨯ 后几秒内变成 `Aborted`，日志只有一条 `finished: aborted`。
- 活 job 路径未改动：`jobs.cancelJob()` 仍是第一步，返回 true 时不会再动存储。

---

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

Closes #61

## Problem

The in-memory `jobs` table and the persisted `data/state.json` drift apart. Any server restart (the `npm run cc:restart` a Deploy triggers, Restart main, a manual restart) kills every child and wipes the job table, but storage still says `working` / `deploying` / `merging`. `cancel` only looks at the in-memory job, finds nothing, returns `{cancelled:false}` and touches nothing — so the row stays stuck forever, the repo's working-tree lock is never released, and every other issue in that repo keeps showing `Waiting — another PR creation is running in this repo…`. The client ignored the cancel response entirely, so Abort didn't even print a message.

## Changes

**server.js** — new `abortAction(repo, issue, action, prNumber?)`, used by all three cancel routes (work / deploy / merge):
- live job → `jobs.cancelJob()` kills it as before (the terminal state is still written by the job's own `close` handler, avoiding a double write);
- no live job → `store.forceAbort()` settles the stored record as `aborted`;
- returns `{ cancelled, reconciled, aborted }` so the client can tell "killed a process" from "cleared a phantom".

Startup now also runs `store.reconcileOrphanedJobs()` alongside the existing admin-turn recovery, logging how many it settled.

**lib/store.js** — new:
- `forceAbort(repo, issue, action, prNumber)`: flips a record to `aborted` only while it is still in that action's live status, sets `finishedAt`, recomputes `durationMs`, and appends an explanatory line to the transcript. Idempotent; returns whether it actually changed anything.
- `reconcileOrphanedJobs(isRunning)`: sweeps every record, skips anything `isRunning(key)` reports as live (never touches a real job), and settles the rest.

**public/index.html** — all three abort handlers now read the response through a new `afterAbort()`: on a reconcile it logs `[… was no longer running — the stuck row has been cleared]` and immediately triggers `reconcile*` to repaint; on `aborted:false` it says there was nothing to abort. `reconcileWork/Deploy/Merge` also gained a per-tag de-dup guard — page load already polls, and Abort asking again produced two `finished` lines and two notifications.

## Verification

Verified against the actually-stuck records (issue #58's Create PR, ios-diet-expert #87's Deploy #105):

- Cancel on a phantom: `{"cancelled":false,"reconciled":true,"aborted":true}`; a second call returns `{"cancelled":false,"reconciled":false,"aborted":false}` (idempotent).
- Restart: startup logs `Marked 1 interrupted job(s) as aborted: cloud-copilot#58:work`, the status becomes `aborted`, `activeWorkIssues` empties.
- Browser: clicking ⨯ on a `Deploying…` row flips it to `Aborted` within seconds, with a single `finished: aborted` log line.
- The live path is untouched: `jobs.cancelJob()` is still tried first, and storage is left alone when it returns true.

</details>

data.body:
Closes #58

## 改动

每行 PR workflow 最左侧新增同步徽章：

| 徽章 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `⇣N` | 落后基分支 N 个 commit |
| `⚠` / `⚠N` | 与基分支存在 merge conflict（带落后数） |
| `·` | 不落后且无冲突 |
| `?` | GitHub 尚未算出 / 未同步 |

hover 的 title 给出完整说明：基分支、behindBy / aheadBy、mergeable 状态、mergeStateStatus、采集时间。

## 数据采集（lib/gh.js）

新增 `listPrSyncStatus(ownerRepo, { force })`：

1. 一次 GraphQL 拿全部 open PR 的 `mergeable` / `mergeStateStatus` / `baseRefName` / `headRefName`；
2. 一次 alias 化的 `repository.ref(base).compare(headRef:)` 拿 `aheadBy` / `behindBy` / `status`，按基分支分组，跨仓 PR 用 `owner:branch`；
3. GitHub 的 `mergeable` 是惰性计算的，首次常返回 `UNKNOWN` 并触发后台任务，因此对仍是 UNKNOWN 的 PR 2.5s 后补查一次（只补一次，其余交给下次刷新）。

结果进现有 L2 缓存（`prSync`），与 issues / prs / prCommits 共用 TTL 与 force 语义。`gh api graphql` 在响应带 `errors` 时会非零退出（例如分支已删除），新增 `graphqlLenient()` 仍解析 stdout，其余 PR 不受影响；彻底失败时回退到上次缓存。

## 持久化（lib/store.js + server.js）

- PR 记录新增 `sync` 字段（`baseRefName / behindBy / aheadBy / compareStatus / mergeable / mergeStateStatus / behind / conflict / checkedAt`）。
- `syncRepoFromGitHub()` 与 `GET /api/repos/:name/issues/:n/prs` 两条路径都写入，后台刷新和手动「↻ PRs」都会更新。
- 通过 `getStatuses()` / `/record` / `prsArray()` 一起下发；老 state.json 无该字段时渲染成 `?`，不报错。

## 验证

- `listPrSyncStatus` 对本仓 14 个 open PR 返回正确的 behindBy 与 CONFLICTING/MERGEABLE。
- 触发 `/api/repos/cloud-copilot/issues?refresh=1` 后，`data/state.json` 中 PR 记录带有 `sync`。
- 浏览器实测：#57 显示 `⇣3`、#50 显示 `⚠13`、#18 显示 `·`，workflow 条对齐未被打乱（行缩进同步调整，桌面/手机断点都改了）。

---

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

Closes #58

## Changes

Every PR workflow row gets a sync badge on the far left:

| Badge | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `⇣N` | Behind the base branch by N commits |
| `⚠` / `⚠N` | Merge conflict with the base branch (with the behind count) |
| `·` | Not behind, no conflict |
| `?` | GitHub hasn't computed it yet / not synced |

The hover title spells it out: base branch, behindBy / aheadBy, mergeable state, mergeStateStatus, and when it was checked.

## Collection (lib/gh.js)

New `listPrSyncStatus(ownerRepo, { force })`:

1. one GraphQL call for every open PR's `mergeable` / `mergeStateStatus` / `baseRefName` / `headRefName`;
2. one aliased `repository.ref(base).compare(headRef:)` call for `aheadBy` / `behindBy` / `status`, grouped by base branch, cross-repo PRs addressed as `owner:branch`;
3. GitHub computes `mergeable` lazily and usually answers `UNKNOWN` first while kicking off the background job, so PRs still UNKNOWN are re-queried once after 2.5s (once only — the next refresh covers the rest).

Results land in the existing L2 cache (`prSync`), sharing TTL and force semantics with issues / prs / prCommits. `gh api graphql` exits non-zero whenever the response carries `errors` (e.g. a deleted branch), so `graphqlLenient()` parses stdout anyway and the other PRs are unaffected; a total failure falls back to the previous cache.

## Persistence (lib/store.js + server.js)

- PR records gain a `sync` field (`baseRefName / behindBy / aheadBy / compareStatus / mergeable / mergeStateStatus / behind / conflict / checkedAt`).
- Written on both `syncRepoFromGitHub()` and `GET /api/repos/:name/issues/:n/prs`, so the background refresh and the manual "↻ PRs" button both update it.
- Shipped to the client via `getStatuses()` / `/record` / `prsArray()`; older state.json files without the field render as `?` instead of erroring.

## Verification

- `listPrSyncStatus` returns correct behindBy and CONFLICTING/MERGEABLE for all 14 open PRs of this repo.
- After hitting `/api/repos/cloud-copilot/issues?refresh=1`, PR records in `data/state.json` carry `sync`.
- Browser check: #57 shows `⇣3`, #50 shows `⚠13`, #18 shows `·`, and the workflow bars stay aligned (row indents adjusted for both desktop and phone breakpoints).

</details>

Closes #56.

## 问题

`buildChangelog()` 把 PR 标题原文当成 TestFlight 的 What to Test，结果：英文 note、`feat:` 前缀泄漏、`(closes #79)` 重复一次、双语标题两半都发、兜底是 `v1.0 (build 63)`、上限 500 字符。

## 改动

新增 [`lib/changelog.js`](lib/changelog.js)，`buildChangelog()` 被 `resolveChangelog()` 取代，两层：

1. **确定性归一化**（永远执行）：剥 shell 危险字符（最终要塞进 `changelog:'…'` 单引号）、issue 引用（`(closes #79)` / `fixes #7` / 结尾裸 `#7`）、conventional-commit 前缀（`feat:` / `fix(ui)!:` / 全角 `docs：`），双语 `中文 / English` 标题取中文一半，截到 40 字。
2. **中文化**（尽力而为）：归一化后仍不是中文时，跑一次 headless `copilot -p`，只读回 `WHAT_TO_TEST:` 那一行。二进制缺失 / 非零退出 / 超时 / 回复里没有中文 —— 一律回落到第 1 步的文案，**绝不阻塞或失败 deploy**。

兜底文案改成 `v1.4 构建 63（暂无变更说明）`。

| 环境变量 | 默认 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CHANGELOG_MODEL` | `claude-haiku-4.5` | 翻译用的模型；这一步在 deploy 前串行执行，所以刻意用小模型 |
| `CHANGELOG_TIMEOUT_MS` | `60000` | 超时就用归一化后的文案 |

## 实测（真实 CLI，ios-diet-expert 的真实 PR 标题）

| PR 标题 | What to Test |
| --- | --- |
| `feat: Add household size, default goal, and servings preferences to Settings (closes #39)` | 新增家庭人数和默认目标设置 |
| `Add first-launch onboarding flow` | 新增首次启动引导流程 |
| `Add immersive hands-free cooking mode` | 新增沉浸式免手烹饪模式 |
| `ci: wire Xcode Cloud build to CI/CD` | Xcode Cloud 构建现已接入 CI/CD 流程 |
| `[AI] 语音报食材入库(OpenAI Whisper)` | 现已支持语音报食材入库(OpenAI Whisper) |
| `将 Cook Now 改造为可复用的做饭任务流程 / Cook Now as a reusable cooking task flow (closes #79)` | 将 Cook Now 改造为可复用的做饭任务流程（未调模型，走确定性路径） |

每次约 10 秒。

## 两个容易踩的点（都写进了注释和测试）

- **两个不同的"是不是中文"阈值**：入口判断用严格的 `isMostlyChinese()`（汉字数 ≥ 拉丁字母数），校验模型回复用宽松的 `hasHan()`。用严格的那个去卡回复，「接入 Xcode Cloud 到 CI/CD」这种完全合格的结果会被判为翻译失败并回退成英文 —— 第一版就是这么错的。
- **`/g` 正则的 `lastIndex`**：计数正则（`/g`）和成员判断正则（无 `/g`）分开，否则同一个 `.test()` 在相同输入上会 true/false 交替。有专门的回归测试。

## 测试

新增 `npm test`（`node --test`，无新依赖），10 个用例覆盖确定性部分 —— 前缀、issue 引用、双语、shell 注入字符、截断、两个中文判断、两条兜底路径。翻译路径通过传一个不存在的 `copilotBin` 来验证回落行为。

```
# tests 10
# pass 10
# fail 0
```

data.body:
Closes #54

## 改动

分支被 linked worktree（哪怕是 `locked` 的）占用时，主仓库里的 `git checkout <branch>` 会直接 fatal（`already used by worktree`），导致 Deploy 硬失败（见 #54 里的 `[deploy #48] finished: failed`）。

新增统一 helper `checkoutBranchCwd(repoPath, branch)`，返回本次任务真正应该使用的工作目录：

- `worktreePathForBranch()` — 从 `git worktree list --porcelain` 找出占用该分支的 linked worktree；
- `worktreeIsDisposable()` — 只有工作区干净（`status --porcelain` 为空）**且** `origin/<branch>..HEAD` 为空（无未推送提交）才算可安全移除；无法证明安全（缺少远端跟踪引用、git 报错）一律视为不安全；
- `releaseWorktree()` — `worktree unlock`（未锁定则忽略）→ `worktree remove` → `worktree prune`；
- 可安全移除 → 释放后回到主仓库 `git checkout`，**在本地部署**；不可安全移除 → 目录原样保留，任务直接在该 worktree 目录里运行，不再失败也不会丢工作。

iOS TestFlight 部署、shell 部署、PR chat 三条路径共用该 helper，`jobs.startJob` 的 `cwd`、build number 计算、`readMarketingVersion` 都改用其返回目录。所有 git 调用保持参数数组形式（分支名来自 GitHub，绝不经过 shell）。README 补充了这一行为说明。

## 验证

在临时仓库（bare remote + 主仓库 + linked worktree）上实测四种情况：

| 场景 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 干净且已推送的 **locked** worktree | 已释放，`cwd` 返回主仓库，主仓库 HEAD 切到该分支 ✅ |
| worktree 有未提交改动 | 目录保留，`cwd` 返回该 worktree ✅ |
| worktree 有未推送提交 | 目录保留，`cwd` 返回该 worktree ✅ |
| 分支未被任何 worktree 占用 | 与原行为一致：fetch + checkout，`cwd` 为主仓库 ✅ |

另外 `node --check server.js` 通过。

---

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

Closes #54

## Changes

When a branch is held by a linked worktree (even a `locked` one), `git checkout <branch>` in the main repository fails outright (`already used by worktree`), so Deploy hard-fails (see `[deploy #48] finished: failed` in #54).

A single new helper, `checkoutBranchCwd(repoPath, branch)`, returns the working directory the job should actually use:

- `worktreePathForBranch()` — finds the linked worktree holding the branch via `git worktree list --porcelain`;
- `worktreeIsDisposable()` — only a clean working tree (`status --porcelain` empty) **and** an empty `origin/<branch>..HEAD` (no unpushed commits) counts as safe to remove; anything unprovable (missing remote-tracking ref, git errors) counts as unsafe;
- `releaseWorktree()` — `worktree unlock` (ignored when not locked) → `worktree remove` → `worktree prune`;
- safe → release it, `git checkout` in the main repo, and **deploy locally**; unsafe → leave the directory untouched and run the job inside that worktree, so it neither fails nor loses work.

The iOS TestFlight deploy, shell deploy, and PR chat paths all share the helper; `jobs.startJob`'s `cwd`, the build-number computation and `readMarketingVersion` all use its returned directory. All git invocations stay in argument-array form (branch names come from GitHub and never reach a shell). README documents the behavior.

## Verification

Exercised against a scratch repo (bare remote + main repo + linked worktree), all four cases:

| Scenario | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Clean, fully pushed **locked** worktree | Released; `cwd` is the main repo, whose HEAD is now the branch ✅ |
| Worktree with uncommitted changes | Kept; `cwd` is that worktree ✅ |
| Worktree with unpushed commits | Kept; `cwd` is that worktree ✅ |
| Branch held by no worktree | Unchanged behavior: fetch + checkout, `cwd` is the main repo ✅ |

`node --check server.js` also passes.

</details>

data.body:
Closes #52

在 A 机器点了 Create PR,到 B 机器打开首页看不到 —— 但点进 PR detail page 就看到了。

## 为什么 Pinned 是对的,列表是错的

同一张卡片(`renderIssue`),三条取数路径:

```
仓库列表(首页)          📌 Pinned / PR detail
──────────────────       ──────────────────────
loadIssues()             每次都 fetch /issues
  ↓
L1 localStorage
15 分钟内命中
→ 一个请求都不发         → 永远是最新的
```

`/api/repos/:name/issues` 的响应里混了两类新鲜度完全不同的东西:

- **GitHub 元数据**(number / title / labels)—— 受速率限制,缓存 15 分钟完全合理
- **本机实时状态**(`status.work` / `status.prs[].deploy` / `.merge`、`activeWorkIssues`)—— 来自 `state.json` 和内存里的 job 表

`writeIssueCache()` 把整个 payload 原样冻进 localStorage,于是第二类跟着被冻了 15 分钟。

**显示不对只是表象。** `renderIssue` 的重连是这么触发的:

```js
if (st.work.status === 'working') reconcileWork();
```

`st` 来自那份陈旧缓存。状态是 `idle` → 不调 `reconcileWork()` → 不重连、不轮询、也不 `repoCtx.setActive()`。首页在长达 15 分钟里**完全不知道这个仓库正忙**,而整个仓库锁的 UI 提示(其他 issue 变灰 + 「⏸ Waiting」)正是靠它。

那个 60 秒的后台补水也救不了 —— 它第一个条件就是「还在 TTL 内就跳过」。

截图里的同步胶囊 `🌍22m 💾12m ↻3m` 就是现场证据:本地副本 12 分钟前的,没到 15 分钟,这次渲染压根没问过服务器。

## 改法

新增 `GET /api/repos/:name/statuses?n=1,2,3`,只返回实时那一半:

```json
{ "repo": "cloud-copilot",
  "statuses": { "42": { "work": {...}, "prs": [...] } },
  "activeWorkIssues": [42] }
```

只读 `state.json` + 内存 job 表,**不碰 `gh`,不碰 L2 缓存**,所以可以随便调。

命中 L1 后照旧瞬间画出来(L1 的意义保住了),紧接着拉一次 statuses 合并,**真有变化才重画**。

## 三处容易踩的地方

### 1. 回写 L1 必须沿用原来的 `localAt`

否则每次补丁都在给 GitHub 那一半的 15 分钟 TTL 续期,访问够勤的人的 issue 列表就**再也不刷新了**。所以 `writeIssueCache()` 多了一个 `localAt` 参数。

### 2. 有 log 面板开着时不重画

重画会拆 DOM,而 SSE 正往里写。`.worklog.show / .prlog.show / .mergelog.show` 任一存在就跳过。

### 3. 跳过重画时**也不能回写缓存**

这条是我自己第一版踩进去的坑,验证时抓到的:先写缓存再判断能不能重画,于是「面板开着」那一次把变化写进了缓存却没画出来 —— 下一次比对时缓存已经等于服务器了,**变化被永久吞掉**,面板关掉之后也不会再补上。

那份陈旧缓存是「这个变化还没应用」的唯一记录。所以现在的顺序是:比对 → 判断能不能画 → **能画才写缓存**。

## 顺带

60 秒的后台补水对还在 TTL 内的仓库也拉一次 statuses(零 `gh` 成本),这样页面开着的时候,别的机器发起的任务一分钟内也能显示出来 —— 不用等到有人手动刷新。

## 验证

主仓库 main 上没有测试框架(`npm test` 是 #48 才引入的),所以是在真实服务器 + 浏览器里逐条跑的。手法:把 `state.json` 里 `cloud-copilot#42` 的 `work.status` 改成 `working`,模拟「另一台机器发起了任务」;测完按备份还原,已 `diff` 确认字节一致。

| # | 场景 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | L1 缓存 31 秒新,服务器侧任务已启动 → 卡片显示 `Creating PR…` | ✅ |
| 2 | 打桩让 `activeWorkIssues: [42]` → 其余 10 条全部变灰,`⏸ Waiting` 显示 | ✅ |
| 3 | 无变化时再补丁 → DOM 探针存活(没有无谓重画),`localAt` 不变 | ✅ |
| 4 | `.worklog.show` 开着 + 服务器状态已变 → 重画被抑制,**缓存保持陈旧** | ✅ |
| 5 | 关掉面板后下一次补丁 → 变化被正确应用,回到 idle | ✅ |
| 6 | `/statuses` 参数校验:`?n=abc,-1,0, 47 ` → 只留 47;无 `n` → `{}`;未知 repo → 404 | ✅ |
| 7 | 全程 console 零报错 | ✅ |

接口开销:`/statuses` ~285ms vs `/issues` ~395ms,且前者不产生任何 `gh` 子进程(两者的固定成本都来自 `resolveRepo` → `gh.listRepos` 的本地 git 调用,与本 PR 无关)。

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

data.body:
Closes #27

## 做了什么

推送不再依赖 Copilot CLI 的 `sessionEnd` hook（它只拿得到 `{sessionId, cwd, reason}`），改由 **server 端**在每个 job 进入终态时发出，与网页内通知同源（`job.meta` + `onDone` 返回的 result）。

新增 `lib/notifier.js`，由 `lib/jobs.js` 在 job 结束时调用：

| 场景 | 通知 |
| --- | --- |
| Create PR 成功 | `✅ Create PR · cloud-copilot#27` ＋ issue 标题、`本 repo 第 2 个 Create PR`、PR 链接 |
| Deploy 失败 | `❌ Deploy · ios-diet-expert PR #112 失败` ＋ PR 标题、错误首行 |
| Admin chat | `✅ Admin chat · cloud-copilot · 「刷新页面后聊天新开了一个 tab」` ＋ 本轮回复摘要 |
| PR chat 中断 | `⚠️ PR chat · cloud-copilot PR #48 · 「再加一个测试按钮」 已中断` |

- **标题 = 任务标识**：action · repo#issue / repo PR #n（对话类再带上会话 title）；非成功状态加后缀。
- **正文 = 摘要 + 关键结果**：issue/PR 标题或对话标题 + 本轮回复末段的一句话摘要（剥掉 CLI 的 `Changes/AI Credits/Tokens/Resume` footer 和工具日志）+ PR 链接 / TestFlight build 号 / 错误首行。
- **Tags** 决定前缀 emoji（✅ / ❌ / ⚠️），失败用更高的 ntfy priority。
- **Click** 深链回 app：`#/pr/<repo>/<issue>/<pr>`、`#/preissue/<repo>/<id>`，Admin 对话新增了 `#/admin/chat/<id>` 路由。

## 实现要点

- **配置化**：`~/.config/cloud-copilot/notify.env`（模板见 `setup/notify.env.example`，`setup.sh` 会自动创建），也可用环境变量覆盖；文件改动会被自动重新读取，无需重启。**未配置 topic 时完全静默，不发也不报错。**
- **不影响 job**：推送 fire-and-forget，10s 超时，全程 try/catch，失败只 `console.warn`；同一 job key 60s 内只推一次。
- **不再重复推送**：job 子进程注入 `CLOUD_COPILOT_JOB=1`，本机 `~/Repos/hooks/copilot-notify.sh` 检测到就 `exit 0`，所以旧的泛化 `[repo] session complete` 不会再出现（其他非 cloud-copilot 的 Copilot CLI session 仍照旧通知）。
- **可自检**：`GET /api/settings/ntfy` 返回状态（topic 做了脱敏），`POST /api/settings/ntfy/test` 发一条测试推送；🔔 Alerts 抽屉里新增了对应的状态行和 **Test phone push** 按钮。

## 验证

- 用一个假的 ntfy server 跑了 Create PR / Deploy / Admin chat / PR chat 四个 job：**四条通知标题、正文、tag、深链各不相同**；失败（priority 4 + ❌）与中断（⚠️）和成功可区分。
- 同 key 连推两次 → 只发 1 条；删掉 topic 后 → 0 条、无报错。
- 起真实 server 跑了一轮 admin chat job：推送正文是本轮回复摘要，并确认子进程里 `CLOUD_COPILOT_JOB=1`。
- 浏览器里验证 `#/admin` 与 `#/admin/chat/<id>` 能跳到 Admin tab 并加载该对话，手动切回 Home 会清掉 hash；抽屉里的 Test phone push 按钮真的发出了推送，控制台无报错。

---

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

Closes #27

## What this does

Pushes no longer come from the Copilot CLI `sessionEnd` hook (which only ever sees `{sessionId, cwd, reason}`). The **server** now sends one push per job the moment it reaches a terminal state, built from the same source as the in-app notifications (`job.meta` + the result returned by `onDone`).

New `lib/notifier.js`, called from `lib/jobs.js`:

| Case | Notification |
| --- | --- |
| Create PR succeeded | `✅ Create PR · cloud-copilot#27` + issue title, "2nd Create PR for this repo", PR link |
| Deploy failed | `❌ Deploy · ios-diet-expert PR #112 失败` + PR title, first line of the error |
| Admin chat | `✅ Admin chat · cloud-copilot · 「刷新页面后聊天新开了一个 tab」` + a one-line gist of that turn's reply |
| PR chat aborted | `⚠️ PR chat · cloud-copilot PR #48 · 「再加一个测试按钮」 已中断` |

- **Title = task identity**: action · repo#issue / repo PR #n, plus the conversation title for chat turns, plus a status suffix when it didn't succeed.
- **Body = subject + result**: issue/PR or chat title, a one-sentence gist of the final answer (CLI `Changes/AI Credits/Tokens/Resume` footer and tool-log lines stripped), then the PR link / TestFlight build number / first error line.
- **Tags** drive the leading emoji (✅ / ❌ / ⚠️); failures get a higher ntfy priority.
- **Click** deep-links back into the app: `#/pr/<repo>/<issue>/<pr>`, `#/preissue/<repo>/<id>`, and a new `#/admin/chat/<id>` route for admin conversations.

## Implementation notes

- **Configurable**: `~/.config/cloud-copilot/notify.env` (template in `setup/notify.env.example`, created by `setup.sh`), overridable by env vars, re-read when the file changes. **With no topic configured nothing is sent and nothing errors.**
- **Never affects a job**: fire-and-forget, 10s timeout, fully try/caught, failures only `console.warn`; same job key pushes at most once per 60s.
- **No duplicate pushes**: jobs spawn with `CLOUD_COPILOT_JOB=1`, and `~/Repos/hooks/copilot-notify.sh` exits early when it sees it, so the old generic `[repo] session complete` is gone for cloud-copilot's runs while other Copilot CLI sessions still get it.
- **Self-check**: `GET /api/settings/ntfy` (topic masked) and `POST /api/settings/ntfy/test`, surfaced in the 🔔 Alerts drawer as a status line and a **Test phone push** button.

## Verification

- Ran Create PR / Deploy / Admin chat / PR chat jobs against a fake ntfy server: **four notifications, all distinct** in title, body, tag and deep link; failed (priority 4, ❌) and aborted (⚠️) are distinguishable from success.
- Same key twice → 1 push; topic removed → 0 pushes, no errors.
- Ran a real admin-chat job through the server: the body is the reply's gist, and the child process really has `CLOUD_COPILOT_JOB=1`.
- In the browser, `#/admin` and `#/admin/chat/<id>` open the Admin tab and load that conversation, switching back to Home clears the hash, and the Test phone push button really published — no console errors.

</details>

Closes #49

## 做了什么

Merge 成功之后自动收尾：关闭对应 issue，并关闭该 issue 名下其他仍然 OPEN 的 PR。

- 新增 `lib/mergeCleanup.js`：
  - 先用 `gh pr view` 复核被合并的 PR 状态确实是 `MERGED`，否则直接跳过（不会误伤）。
  - 逐个检查该 issue 下的其他 PR，只有 `OPEN` 的才 `gh pr close --comment "Superseded by #N, which was merged for issue #M…" --delete-branch`；已 MERGED / CLOSED 的记入 `skippedPrs`。
  - issue 仍为 `OPEN` 时 `gh issue close --comment "Closed by #N (merged via cloud-copilot)."`；已关闭则只记 `issueAlreadyClosed`。
  - 全流程 best-effort：错误收集进 `errors`，不抛出；随后刷新 gh 缓存让首页立即显示新状态。
  - `MERGE_AUTO_CLEANUP=0` 可完全关闭该行为。
- `server.js`：merge job 的 `onDone` 在 `success` 分支调用清理，结果写进 store（`merge.cleanup`）并随 SSE `done` 下发（`cleanup` / `cleanupMessage`）。清理放在 try/catch 里，绝不会把已成功的 merge 变成 failed。
- `lib/store.js`：`blankMerge()` 增加 `cleanup` 字段 + v6 迁移回填旧记录。
- `public/index.html`：Merge 单元格 tooltip 追加清理说明，merge 日志里多一行 `Post-merge cleanup: …`。
- `README.md`：更新 Merge 行为描述、环境变量表（`MERGE_AUTO_CLEANUP`）、API 表和目录树（同时补上一直缺失的 `mergeRunner.js`）。

## 为什么需要

实测本仓库：issue #25 因 PR #36 合并而关闭，但同属 issue #25 的 PR #35 至今仍是 OPEN；issue #20 的 #23、#31 也都还开着。GitHub 既不会关闭兄弟 PR，也只在 `Closes #N` + 默认分支 base 的前提下才关 issue。

## 验证

- `node --check` 通过（`server.js` / `lib/mergeCleanup.js` / `lib/store.js`）。
- 用桩 `gh` 跑完整正向路径：merged PR #44、兄弟 PR #43(OPEN)、#41(CLOSED)、issue #9(OPEN) → 结果 `issueClosed: true`、`closedPrs: [43]`、`skippedPrs: [41]`，调用序列与预期一致（含 `--delete-branch` 与两条评论）。
- 真实 `gh` 下的防御路径：`MERGE_AUTO_CLEANUP=0` 时完全 no-op；传入一个未合并的 PR（#31）时拒绝清理并记录原因。
- 启动服务器（`PORT=8899`）返回 200，v6 迁移在真实 `data/state.json` 上把历史 merge 记录回填成 `cleanup: null`。

---

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

Closes #49

## What this does

Adds an automatic wrap-up after a successful merge: close the linked issue and close every other still-open PR for that issue.

- New `lib/mergeCleanup.js`:
  - Re-checks with `gh pr view` that the merged PR really is `MERGED`, otherwise it bails out (never cleans up on a failed merge).
  - Walks the issue's other PRs and only closes the `OPEN` ones via `gh pr close --comment "Superseded by #N, which was merged for issue #M…" --delete-branch`; already MERGED/CLOSED ones land in `skippedPrs`.
  - Closes the issue with `gh issue close --comment "Closed by #N (merged via cloud-copilot)."` when it is still `OPEN`; otherwise records `issueAlreadyClosed`.
  - Fully best-effort: errors are collected in `errors` and never thrown; the gh caches are refreshed afterwards so the dashboard reflects the new states immediately.
  - `MERGE_AUTO_CLEANUP=0` disables the whole behaviour.
- `server.js`: the merge job's `onDone` calls the cleanup on the success path, persists the summary in the store (`merge.cleanup`) and ships it over the SSE `done` event (`cleanup` / `cleanupMessage`). It is wrapped in try/catch so it can never turn a successful merge into a failure.
- `lib/store.js`: `blankMerge()` gains a `cleanup` field plus a v6 migration that backfills existing records.
- `public/index.html`: the Merge cell tooltip appends the cleanup summary and the merge log gets a `Post-merge cleanup: …` line.
- `README.md`: updated the Merge behaviour description, the env var table (`MERGE_AUTO_CLEANUP`), the API table and the directory tree (also adding the previously missing `mergeRunner.js`).

## Why

Observed in this repo: issue #25 was closed by merging PR #36, yet PR #35 for the same issue is still OPEN; issue #20 still has both #23 and #31 open. GitHub never closes sibling PRs, and only closes the issue when the body has `Closes #N` and the base is the default branch.

## Verification

- `node --check` passes for `server.js`, `lib/mergeCleanup.js` and `lib/store.js`.
- Full happy path exercised against a stubbed `gh`: merged PR #44, siblings #43 (OPEN) and #41 (CLOSED), issue #9 (OPEN) → `issueClosed: true`, `closedPrs: [43]`, `skippedPrs: [41]`, with the expected call sequence including `--delete-branch` and both comments.
- Guard paths against the real `gh`: `MERGE_AUTO_CLEANUP=0` is a complete no-op, and passing a non-merged PR (#31) refuses the cleanup and records the reason.
- Server boots (`PORT=8899`, HTTP 200) and the v6 migration backfills `cleanup: null` on the real `data/state.json` merge records.

</details>

data.body:
Closes #47

把 cloud-copilot 从「点一下做一件事」变成「打上 label 就自己做完」——并且完全不打扰你本地那份 checkout。

完整设计见 [`docs/task-queue-design.md`](docs/task-queue-design.md)(随本 PR 提交)。

---

## 核心:两个互不相干的世界

```
交互世界 · 你的 checkout            调度世界 · 专用 worktree
~/Repos/<repo>/                    ~/.cloud-copilot/worktrees/<repo>/
────────────────────────────       ────────────────────────────────
Deploy · Merge · 对话 ·            Create PR · sync-scan ·
Admin 终端 · Restart main          sync-branch · sync-conflict
人点的                             定时器触发
不排队,立即执行                   每仓库一条串行队列
现有 findOtherRepoBusyKey 锁       「这个目录只有我在用」
```

**调度器永不触碰主工作树。** 这是整个设计的地基。

最初的方案是让队列 worker 也去抢现有那把 repo 锁,于是必须写一整套交织逻辑:队列发现锁被占要退让、人工动作优先、队列跑着时点 Deploy 会被 Blocked、抢锁的公平性……这些全是因为共用工作树凭空长出来的复杂度。

改成 worktree 隔离后这层交织**整个消失**:现有的锁语义、Deploy / Merge / Chat 路由一行都不用改。两个世界只共用 `.git`,而 git 本就是为多 worktree 并发设计的。代码总量比原方案多约 250 行,但改动面反而小得多。

---

## 做了什么

- **每 30 分钟**巡查带 label(默认 `committed`)且无 PR 的 open issue,自动入队 Create PR
- **每天 03:00** 检查所有 open PR 分支是否落后 `origin/main`。落后的用**纯 git** merge + push 处理,零 token
- 冲突的分支 `merge --abort` 后另起一个 Copilot 任务解决
- **每天 08:00** 生成日报 → `data/reports/`、抽屉的日报页签、可选 Resend 邮件
- 左上角 **⚡ 图标 + 抽屉**:查看 / 置顶 / 移除 / 中止 / 重试 / 暂停某仓库
- 设置面板 **label 多选**,选项来自真实的 `gh label list`(带颜色圆点)
- 进度原子落盘 `data/queue.json`;**失败标红不重试**,**崩溃中断自动重跑一次**
- 队列深度只到 **Create PR** —— Deploy / Merge 仍由人把最后一关
- **零新 npm 依赖**(邮件是一个 `fetch` POST)

---

## 三处值得单独看的设计

### 1. 每个任务结束必须 `git checkout --detach`

git 只允许一个分支在一个 worktree 里 checkout。如果任务跑完还停在 `cc/issue-96` 上,你之后点 Deploy —— 它会在**主树**上 `git checkout cc/issue-96` —— 会直接失败:

```
fatal: 'cc/issue-96' is already checked out at '/Users/.../worktrees/demo'
```

而这个报错离真正的原因很远。`release()` 每次都交还分支所有权,测试 A3.8 / B10 专门钉住这个回归。

### 2. worktree 必须放在 `REPOS_ROOT` 外面

[`lib/gh.js:117`](lib/gh.js#L117) 判定「这是个仓库」的条件是 `.git` 存在 —— 而 worktree 的 `.git` 是个**文件**,`fs.existsSync` 一样返回 true。放进 `REPOS_ROOT` 的话首页会凭空多出一排幽灵仓库。

### 3. `git clean -df`,不是 `-xdf`

少一个 `-x` 意味着 ignored 文件被保留,`node_modules` / `Pods` 活过任务之间,bootstrap 只付一次而不是每个任务付一次。测试 A3.4 钉住这一点。

---

## 对现有代码的改动面

| 文件 | 改动 |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/jobs.js` | 加 `job.finished` Promise + `startJob` 支持 `env` 覆盖 —— 纯增量 |
| `server.js` | 抽出 `startWorkJob()`(行为等价);新增 `/api/queue/*` 等路由;启动拉起 scheduler |
| `server.js` `heldWorkingTreeKeys()` | **唯一的行为性改动**,见下 |
| Deploy / Merge / Chat 路由 | 一行未改 |
| `WORKING_TREE_ACTION_RE` / `manualLocks` | 一行未改 |

### ⚠️ 与设计文档的一处偏离

设计文档写的是「锁相关一行不改」。实际实现时发现这做不到:队列的 Create PR 复用了现有 job key `<repo>#<n>:work`(为了让你在手机上打开 issue 就能看到实时日志流),而这个 key 会被 `WORKING_TREE_ACTION_RE` 匹配上,于是队列跑着的时候你点 Deploy 仍然会被 Blocked —— worktree 隔离就成了徒有其表。

所以 `heldWorkingTreeKeys()` 改成把 `meta.worktree` 的 job 排除在主工作树锁之外。语义上完全正确(这把锁保护的是主 checkout,而 worktree 里的 job 根本不持有它),改动是一个 filter。集成测试 B8/B9 钉住这个契约。

---

## 测试

```bash
npm test
```

**78 个用例全绿**,跑在 Node 内置 `node:test` 上,零测试框架。全程真实 git 与真实 worktree;agent 换成一个假的 `copilot` shell 脚本,因此整条 spawn / stream / abort 链路都被覆盖,又不花一分 token。

| 文件 | 覆盖 |
| --- | --- |
| `test/queue.test.js` (16) | 去重、优先级、cooldown、retry、reconcile 一次/两次、sweep、损坏文件隔离、原子写 |
| `test/queueConfig.test.js` (13) | 缺失/损坏配置、默认启用、总开关、空 token 保留、redact 不泄漏、mtime 失效 |
| `test/worktree.test.js` (14) | 创建/复用/bootstrap/refresh、reset 保留 ignored 删除未跟踪、**分支所有权回归**、冲突态清理 |
| `test/syncTasks.test.js` (7) | behindCount、干净 merge 真的 push 了、冲突 abort 后**工作树干净**、git 复核不轻信 agent |
| `test/report.test.js` (11) | 计数/分组/窗口、空日报、保留期清理、Resend 请求体与失败处理 |
| `test/scheduler.test.js` (8) | 定时判定、**睡过 03:00 醒来补跑**、跨天重新可触发 |
| `test/integration.test.js` (9) | 端到端 create-pr(worktree/分支/PORT 注入)、失败进 cooldown、运行时重查前置条件、中止、崩溃恢复、巡查去重 |

测试过程中抓到并修掉一个真实 bug:macOS 上 `/var/folders` 是符号链接,`git worktree list` 报的是 realpath,导致「worktree 是否已注册」的字符串比较永远为 false,第二次 `ensure()` 会试图重复添加。现在按 realpath 比较。

---

## 手动验证过

- 后端全部路由(`/api/queue`、`/api/queue/config`、`/api/repos/:name/labels` 拉到真实 136 个 label、worktrees、reports)
- 抽屉在**桌面和手机视口**下的渲染;修掉了一个 z-index 问题(手机上导航胶囊盖住抽屉标题)
- 设置面板的 label 多选保存后正确回读(`["committed","enhancement"]`)
- 日报「立即生成」端到端跑通
- 带调度器启动一次:`reconcile` / `worktree prune` / 三个定时器都正常,总开关关闭时对真实仓库零副作用

**未在真实环境验证**(需要你在自己机器上跑):真正让 Copilot 在 worktree 里跑完一个 issue、03:00 那一轮、Resend 真实投递。issue #47 里的 C 组手动验收清单就是给这个用的。

data.body:
Closes #45

## 1. 布局扁平化

每个 issue 从 6 行压到「1 行 issue 头 + 每个 PR 一行 workflow line」。issue 号、标题、pin/GitHub/刷新/删除图标挤进一行；每行的日志/中止/耗时收进 `⋯`，运行中自动展开，没内容时整个 `⋯` 隐藏。

「—」新建行按需显示：**已有 PR 时省掉**，要开第二个 PR 就点绿色的 `PR created` 段，弹确认框后启动。work 处于 working/failed/aborted 时它会回来，保证进度和失败仍可见、log 仍可达。

实测 9 个 issue：workflow line 19 → 12 条，repo body 高度 **2594px → 1043px**（3.6 屏 → 1.4 屏）。

## 2. 分级缓存

| 层 | 位置 | TTL | 耗时 | 存活 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| L1 | 浏览器 localStorage | 15m | 0ms | 页面刷新 |
| L2 | `data/gh-cache.json` + 内存 | 15m | ~5ms | 服务器重启 |
| L3 | `gh` CLI | — | 800ms+ | — |

- 展开 repo 直接从 L1 渲染，未过期**不发任何请求**（实测刷新页面后 issue 请求数为 0）
- 过期后静默拉 L2 并原地更新；该 repo 有任务在跑时跳过，避免拆掉正在写日志的 DOM
- 服务器每小时 force 刷新一轮兜底，跳过繁忙 repo，失败保留旧缓存
- `↻ Refresh` 击穿三层（实测 `data/gh-cache.json` 时间戳同步刷新）
- repo 折叠状态持久化
- toolbar 上的 pill 显示 `☁ 服务器多久前读的 GitHub · 💾 本地多久前复制的 · ↻ 下次同步倒计时`，按较旧的一侧上色

新增 `lib/ghCache.js` 作为 L2；`gh.js` 原来的内存 Map 变成它的镜像，启动时载入，重启后首个请求即命中。

## 3. workflow line 元信息

- `↗` 从行尾移到 PR 号旁边，两者放进固定宽度的 `.wflead`，「新建」行补不可见占位 —— 实测所有 chevron bar 左边缘唯一值只有 315px 一个
- 每条 PR line 下方新增 `⎇ 分支 · 短SHA · 相对时间 · commit 标题`，SHA 链到该 commit
- repo 头显示本地 checkout 的 HEAD 和**所属 issue**

数据来源：新增 `gh.listPrHeadCommits()`，一次 GraphQL 取每个 PR 的最后一个 commit。`gh pr list --json commits` 用不了 —— 它返回所有 PR 的全部 commit，100 个 PR 直接撞 GraphQL 节点上限（`exceeds the maximum limit of 500,000`）。这层是纯装饰，失败退回旧值或空 map，不影响 PR 列表。

## 4. 修复：Create PR 时长/log 的错误归属

一个 issue 只有一条 work 记录，但可以有多个 PR，大多是从 GitHub 发现的。之前每个 PR 行的第一格都显示这条 work 的时长和 log。

实例：issue #26 的 work 是 aborted、`prNumber` 为 null、时长 45h39m（服务器跑一半挂掉、45 小时后重启才标记），却被挂到 PR #33 上 —— 而 PR #33 比那次 work 还早 13 分钟创建。

现在只有 `work.prNumber === pr.prNumber` 的行才显示时长和 log 按钮。核对过 #27：18416 字符真实 transcript、session `910ef427`、13m37s 由 startedAt/finishedAt 算出，PR #34 的创建时间落在该窗口内 —— 数据本身是对的，错的只是把它复制到了别的 PR 行上。

## 5. 修复：未推送 commit 的死链

repo 头的 commit 链接点不开，原因是该 commit 从没推送过，GitHub 上不存在（curl 实测 404）。现在 `gitHeadCommit()` 用 `git branch -r --contains` 判定 `pushed`，未推送时渲染成不可点的 chip 加 `unpushed` 角标。

## 验证

桌面、移动端（375px）、PR 详情页、PreIssues 页都截图确认过。移动端顺带修了 chevron 文字挤压、pill 悬空分隔符、标题限行三处。

## 做了什么

Merge 从"直接调 \`gh pr merge\`"改成走新的 \`lib/mergeRunner.js\`，失败时自动让 Copilot 接手把 merge 做完。

1. **\`lib/mergeRunner.js\`（新增）** — 跑 \`gh pr merge --merge --delete-branch\`，然后轮询 \`gh pr view\` 确认 PR 真的到达 \`MERGED\`（60 次 × 5s，可用 \`MERGE_VERIFY_ATTEMPTS\` / \`MERGE_VERIFY_INTERVAL_MS\` 调）。失败、或命令成功但状态没到 MERGED 时，检查 \`mergeable\`/\`mergeStateStatus\` 判定冲突，再启动 Copilot 自主处理：检出 PR 分支、合入真实 base、解冲突、push、重试 merge、验证结果。通过 \`[cloud-copilot merge recovery] {json}\` marker 把结果回传。
2. **\`server.js\`** — merge 端点改为 spawn mergeRunner，接上 \`onSession\`/\`onProgress\`；解析 marker 得出 \`recoveryAttempted\`/\`conflictResolved\`/\`recoveryMessage\`；任务被取消但 GitHub 已报 MERGED 时算成功；隐藏 issue 时一并取消在跑的 merge job。
3. **\`lib/store.js\` / \`lib/gh.js\`** — merge 记录新增三个恢复字段（含 \`migrate()\` 回填），\`getStatuses()\` 与 \`listAllBuilds()\` 一并暴露；\`gh.getPr()\` 增查 \`state\`。
4. **\`public/index.html\`** — Merge 格子显示 \`Merged · conflict resolved\` / \`Merged · recovered by Copilot\`，TestFlight 卡片追加 \`· conflict resolved\`；merge 流程接入 \`setActive\`/\`clearActive\`。
5. **\`README.md\`** — 功能说明、状态说明、API 表格同步更新。

## 需要留意

因为恢复流程会真实操作共享工作区，\`merge\` 被加进了 \`WORKING_TREE_ACTION_RE\`。这把锁是双向的：普通 merge（两次 API 调用、不碰工作区）现在也会被其他 Deploy/Chat/Create PR 挡住，反过来 merge 在跑时也会把该 repo 其他 issue 置灰。安全但比必要范围粗一些——精确做法是让 mergeRunner 在真要恢复时才申请锁，代价是多一处竞态。

data.body:
Closes #42.

Deploy used to die whenever the repo had uncommitted changes — which on the self-repo is
most of the time, since you edit cloud-copilot in the same clone it deploys from:

```
[error] Failed to check out branch "feature/task-deeplinks": Command failed: git checkout feature/task-deeplinks
```

## What changed

Deploy becomes a **two-phase job** when the working tree is dirty, streaming into the same
deploy log:

1. **Salvage** — a Copilot session driven by the new `salvage-local-changes` skill:
   summarize the changes → open an issue → cut a branch from the latest default branch →
   carry the changes over, resolving conflicts → commit → push → open a PR closing the
   issue. It does **not** merge that PR; recovered work gets human review.
2. **Deploy** — re-check the tree; only if `git status --porcelain` is empty does the PR's
   branch get checked out and the normal deploy run.

A clean tree skips phase 1 entirely — no behaviour change, no extra Copilot session.

Deliberately **not** an auto-stash. A stash is invisible in the UI and gets forgotten; an
issue plus a reviewable PR is the durable form of the same rescue.

## Never lose the work

The whole point is that local changes survive, so every failure path refuses to check out:

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Salvage exits non-zero | Deploy fails, tree untouched, nothing checked out |
| Salvage exits 0 but tree still dirty | Deploy fails, dirty file list shown |
| Abort during salvage | Job ends `aborted`, deploy phase never starts |
| Checkout fails anyway | git's own stderr in the log |

The skill also forbids `git reset --hard`, `git checkout -- .` and `git clean`, and requires
`-u` on the stash so untracked files come along.

## `lib/jobs.js`: multi-phase jobs

`nextPhase(job, exitCode)` returns the next `{bin,args,cwd,phase}` or `null` to finish.
Subscribers, the transcript and the abort handle carry across phases, so the browser sees
one continuous log and one final `done` instead of a stream that ends mid-pipeline.
Throwing from `nextPhase` surfaces the message on the stream and ends the job; a cancelled
job never advances.

Each phase carries **its own** successor rather than inheriting the initial callback —
otherwise `nextPhase` fires after the deploy phase too and re-enters it forever. (I hit
exactly that: an infinite redeploy loop, caught by the test below before it ever ran live.)

Unknown SSE events are already ignored by the frontend, so the new `phase` event needs no
client change.

## Diagnosability

The deploy path's `execFileSync(..., stdio: 'ignore')` calls now go through the existing
`git()` helper, so failures report git's real stderr ("Your local changes to the following
files would be overwritten by checkout: …") instead of `Command failed: git checkout …`.

## Testing

- **Phase machinery**: 13 assertions against `lib/jobs.js` with fake children — both phases
  run in order under one job; banner ordering; single `done`; phase-1 failure skips phase 2
  and reports failed with the reason in the transcript; cancel never advances; single-phase
  jobs behave exactly as before. All pass.
- **Root cause**: reproduced the checkout abort against the real dirty clone, and confirmed
  `err.stderr` carries git's message (the basis for the diagnosability fix).
- **Server**: boots clean from this branch, UI verified at iPhone 17 Pro Max viewport.
- **Not yet exercised**: a live end-to-end salvage run. Triggering one spawns Copilot and
  creates a real issue + PR from whatever is currently uncommitted, so I left that for a
  deliberate run rather than doing it as a side effect of testing.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Closes #39

## 改动内容

让 issue 卡片上的「🗑 Delete issue」按钮**真正删除 GitHub 上的 issue**，而不是像以前那样只做本地隐藏（以前它和右上角的小 🗑 图标行为完全一样，与按钮文案不符）。

- **`lib/gh.js`**：新增 `deleteIssue(ownerRepo, issueNumber)`，执行 `gh issue delete <n> --repo <owner/repo> --yes`，并在 `finally` 里清掉该仓库的 issue 列表缓存，让删除立刻反映到列表上。
- **`server.js`**：新增 `DELETE /api/repos/:name/issues/:n`。顺序是：先取消该 issue 在跑的 `work` job 和每个 PR 的 `deploy:<pr>` job → 再调 `gh issue delete` → **只有 GitHub 确认删除成功后**才 `store.dismissIssue()` 清本地状态。`gh` 失败时返回 502 并原样透出 stderr，本地状态完全不动。原有的 `POST .../hide` 路由保留给隐藏按钮。
- **`public/index.html`**：删除按钮改用强确认——必须手动输入 issue 编号才会继续，输入不匹配或取消则什么都不做；错误经由已有的 `friendlyHttpError()` 弹出。小 🗑 图标按钮仍然只是本地隐藏，tooltip 和确认文案都补充说明了「不会动 GitHub」。

## 验证

在本地起了一个 8899 端口的实例实测：

- 非法 issue 编号 → `400 {"error":"invalid issue number"}`
- 未知仓库 → `404 {"error":"repo not found"}`
- 不存在的 issue（#99999）→ `502 gh issue delete failed: GraphQL: Could not resolve to an issue or pull request with the number of 99999.`，本地状态未被清理
- 端到端：新建一个临时 issue #40 → 调 `DELETE` 返回 `{"ok":true,"deleted":true}` → `gh issue view 40` 报 `Could not resolve to an issue`，确认已在 GitHub 上真删除
- `node --check` 通过（`server.js`、`lib/gh.js`、以及抽取出的 `index.html` 内联脚本）

## 注意

GitHub 删除 issue 是**不可恢复**的，且需要仓库 admin 权限。无权限时用户会看到 `gh` 的真实报错，卡片保留、按钮恢复可用。

---

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

Closes #39

## What changed

The "🗑 Delete issue" button on an issue card now **actually deletes the issue on GitHub** instead of only hiding it locally (previously it behaved exactly like the small 🗑 icon in the card header, contradicting its label).

- **`lib/gh.js`**: adds `deleteIssue(ownerRepo, issueNumber)`, running `gh issue delete <n> --repo <owner/repo> --yes` and dropping that repo's cached issue list in `finally` so the deletion shows up in the list immediately.
- **`server.js`**: adds `DELETE /api/repos/:name/issues/:n`. Order of operations: cancel the issue's in-flight `work` job and every PR's `deploy:<pr>` job → call `gh issue delete` → only clear local state via `store.dismissIssue()` **after GitHub confirms the deletion**. On `gh` failure it returns 502 with the stderr surfaced verbatim and leaves local state untouched. The existing `POST .../hide` route is kept for the hide button.
- **`public/index.html`**: the delete button is now behind a strong confirmation — the user must type the issue number to proceed; a mismatch or cancel does nothing. Errors are shown through the existing `friendlyHttpError()`. The small 🗑 icon button remains a local-only hide, with tooltip and confirm text clarifying it never touches GitHub.

## Verification

Tested against a local instance on port 8899:

- Invalid issue number → `400 {"error":"invalid issue number"}`
- Unknown repo → `404 {"error":"repo not found"}`
- Non-existent issue (#99999) → `502 gh issue delete failed: GraphQL: Could not resolve to an issue or pull request with the number of 99999.`, local state left intact
- End to end: created a throwaway issue #40 → `DELETE` returned `{"ok":true,"deleted":true}` → `gh issue view 40` reports `Could not resolve to an issue`, confirming it was really deleted on GitHub
- `node --check` passes for `server.js`, `lib/gh.js`, and the extracted inline script from `index.html`

## Note

Deleting an issue on GitHub is **irreversible** and requires repo admin permission. Without it, the user sees the real `gh` error, the card stays, and the button is re-enabled.

</details>

把 Home 页面右上角的 `mode:` / `model:` / `⚙ Filter` 三个控件合并成**一个 `⚙ Settings` 下拉**，并在面板里新增 **Restart main** 操作。

Closes #22

## 布局 / 移动端

- 单个 `⚙ Settings` 触发按钮锚定右上角；面板依次包含 **Mode**、**Model**、**This instance**、**Show repositories**。
- 面板宽度 `min(280px, calc(100vw - 24px))`，打开时用 JS 做视口夹取（两侧都不会渲染到屏幕外），保留 `max-height: 60vh; overflow-y: auto`。
- `select` 设为 `width: 100%` + `text-overflow: ellipsis`，长模型名不再决定行宽。
- 新增 `@media (max-width: 560px)` 收紧标题与间距；390px 视口下 `scrollWidth === clientWidth`（无水平溢出），320px 下同样成立。
- 持久化行为完全不变：mode/model 仍在 change 时 POST，repo 过滤器仍写同一个 `localStorage` key。

## 无障碍 / 状态可见性

- `aria-haspopup`、`aria-expanded`（随开合更新）、`aria-controls`。
- `Esc` 关闭并把焦点还给触发器；外部点击同样关闭。
- 过滤器隐藏了任意仓库时，触发器上显示一个圆点徽标，折叠后不会藏起激活状态。

## Restart main

新增接口：

- `GET /api/health` → `{ ok, pid, startedAt }`
- `GET /api/settings/self` → `{ repo, branch, defaultBranch, dirty, busy }`（非自身仓库返回 `{ repo: null }`）
- `POST /api/settings/self/restart-main`

行为与 issue 中列出的必须处理点一一对应：

1. **自杀式重启** —— 不再依赖 `pkill`。接口**先把 JSON 结果 flush 给前端**，然后 spawn 一个 `detached: true`（独立 session）的 shell，它轮询等待当前进程 PID 消失后再执行 `npm start`；服务端随后主动 `process.exit(0)`。交接是确定性的，也不会误杀其他 `node` 进程。
   > 实测：原先的 `npm run cc:restart` 由服务端自己 spawn 时，`pkill` 并没有杀掉自己，导致新进程 `EADDRINUSE` 起不来 —— 正是 issue 里描述的坑。
2. **前端等回来** —— 轮询 `GET /api/health` 直到返回**不同的 `startedAt``**（120s 超时 + 失败提示），期间显示进度，不会卡在已断掉的请求上；成功后刷新页面（服务端刚换了它提供的代码）。
3. **脏工作树** —— 先 `git stash push --include-untracked -m "cloud-copilot restart-main <ISO 时间>"`，绝不静默丢弃；stash message 会回显在前端，点击前的确认框也会提示。
4. **复用工作树锁** —— 新增 `restart` 动作到 `WORKING_TREE_ACTION_RE`，并新增一个 `manualLocks` 集合（该动作没有对应的子进程 job），`findOtherRepoBusyKey` 同时看两者；冲突返回 `409` + 既有 `describeBusyKey` 文案。
5. **仅自身仓库可见** —— 服务端按 **(device, inode)** 而非路径字符串识别自身仓库（macOS 上 `realpath` 不规范化大小写，`~/repos` 与 `~/Repos` 会失配），其他情况返回 `{ repo: null }`，前端隐藏整个 This instance 区块。
6. **显示当前分支** —— 面板显示自身仓库当前分支，重启完成后刷新。

## 验证

- 用一个隔离的临时 clone（模拟 `main` 落后于 origin）完整跑通：脏工作树 → stash → `checkout main` → `pull --ff-only` 快进到新提交 → 服务以**新 PID / 新 `startedAt`** 重新起来 → 锁释放；`git stash list` 里改动完好。
- 通过真实 UI 点击（含确认框）复跑同一流程，前端轮询恢复并自动刷新。
- Playwright 在 390px / 320px / 1440px 下检查：无水平溢出、面板始终在视口内、`Esc` 关闭并回焦、外部点击关闭、`aria-expanded` 正确、徽标随过滤状态开关，桌面端无回归。

---

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

Collapses the three top-right Home controls (`mode:` / `model:` / `⚙ Filter`) into **one `⚙ Settings` dropdown**, and adds a **Restart main** action inside that panel.

Closes #22

## Layout / mobile

- A single `⚙ Settings` trigger anchored top-right; the panel contains **Mode**, **Model**, **This instance**, **Show repositories** in that order.
- Panel width `min(280px, calc(100vw - 24px))`, clamped in JS on open so it never renders off-screen on either edge; keeps `max-height: 60vh; overflow-y: auto`.
- Selects are `width: 100%` with `text-overflow: ellipsis`, so long model names no longer set the row width.
- Added `@media (max-width: 560px)` for the title/spacing; at a 390px viewport `scrollWidth === clientWidth` (no horizontal overflow), and the same holds at 320px.
- Persistence is untouched: mode/model still POST on change, the repo filter still writes the same `localStorage` key.

## Accessibility / visible state

- `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded` (kept in sync), `aria-controls`.
- `Esc` closes and returns focus to the trigger; outside click closes too.
- A dot badge on the trigger when the repo filter is hiding anything, so collapsing the controls doesn't hide active state.

## Restart main

New endpoints:

- `GET /api/health` → `{ ok, pid, startedAt }`
- `GET /api/settings/self` → `{ repo, branch, defaultBranch, dirty, busy }` (`{ repo: null }` when not self-hosted)
- `POST /api/settings/self/restart-main`

Mapping to the required points from the issue:

1. **Suicidal restart** — no longer relies on `pkill`. The endpoint **flushes its JSON result first**, then spawns a `detached: true` (own session) shell that waits for this process's PID to disappear before running `npm start`; the server then calls `process.exit(0)`. The handover is deterministic and unrelated `node` processes are never killed.
   > Observed in testing: when the server spawned the original `npm run cc:restart`, `pkill` did not actually kill it, so the relaunched process died with `EADDRINUSE` — exactly the hazard the issue describes.
2. **The client waits for it to come back** — polls `GET /api/health` until a *different* `startedAt` answers (120s timeout with a failure message), showing progress instead of hanging on a dead request; reloads on success (the server just swapped the code it serves).
3. **Dirty working tree** — `git stash push --include-untracked -m "cloud-copilot restart-main <ISO timestamp>"` first, never silently discarded; the stash message is echoed back to the client and the confirm dialog warns beforehand.
4. **Reuses the working-tree lock** — adds a `restart` action to `WORKING_TREE_ACTION_RE` plus a `manualLocks` set (this action has no child-process job), with `findOtherRepoBusyKey` consulting both; conflicts return `409` with the existing `describeBusyKey` message.
5. **Self repo only** — the server identifies its own repo by **(device, inode)** rather than path string (macOS `realpath` doesn't normalise case, so `~/repos` vs `~/Repos` mismatched); otherwise it returns `{ repo: null }` and the client hides the whole This instance section.
6. **Shows the current branch** — displayed in the panel and refreshed once the restart completes.

## Verification

- Ran the whole flow against an isolated temporary clone (with `main` deliberately behind origin): dirty tree → stash → `checkout main` → `pull --ff-only` fast-forwards → server comes back with a **new PID / new `startedAt`** → lock released; the changes are intact in `git stash list`.
- Repeated the same flow through the real UI (including the confirm dialog); the client polled for recovery and reloaded automatically.
- Playwright checks at 390px / 320px / 1440px: no horizontal overflow, panel always inside the viewport, `Esc` closes + refocuses, outside click closes, `aria-expanded` correct, badge toggles with the filter, no desktop regression.

</details>

data.body:
Closes #24

## 做了什么

把 chat UI 的自制 markdown 子集（`mdToHtml()`，约 20 行）和「每个 SSE chunk 追加一个 DOM 文本节点」的流式做法，换成一个**共享的流式 markdown 渲染器** `public/chat-render.js`（`window.CCChat`），接入全部四个流式界面：

- PR 详情 chat panel
- PreIssue chat panel
- Admin Terminal
- 使用 `pumpSSE` 的 pipeline 日志面板（Create PR / Deploy / Merge）

库栈全部 **vendor 进 `public/vendor/`**，运行时不访问任何第三方 CDN（本应用无构建步骤、静态伺服 `public/`、通过局域网使用）：

| 文件 | 库 | 版本 | 许可 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `marked.min.js` | marked | 15.0.7 | MIT |
| `purify.min.js` | DOMPurify | 3.2.4 | Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 |
| `highlight.min.js` | highlight.js（common 语言包） | 11.11.1 | BSD-3-Clause |
| `highlight-github-dark.min.css` | highlight.js GitHub Dark 主题 | 11.11.1 | BSD-3-Clause |

## 实现要点

**流式过程中的增量 markdown。** 累积缓冲区按 ~60ms 节流重新解析，源文本被切成顶层 markdown 块；只有源文本真正变化的块会被重建，其余 DOM 原样保留。未闭合的 ``` 围栏在解析前补上闭合符，所以代码从第一行起就以代码呈现，而不是在结尾突然「跳变」。

**净化。** 模型输出不可信，所有 HTML 过 DOMPurify：脚本、内联样式、事件处理器、iframe/object/form、`javascript:` URL 一律无法存活。链接强制 `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"`。GFM 任务列表复选框是唯一放行的 `<input>`，且被削成惰性 checkbox（清空全部属性后只留 `type=checkbox`/`disabled`/`checked`）。

**粘底自动滚动。** 仅当用户已在距底部 40px 以内时才固定到底部；否则不动滚动位置，并显示「↓ Jump to latest」药丸按钮。

**其他。** 代码围栏有语法高亮 + 复制按钮；每条助手消息有复制按钮（Safari 在明文 HTTP 局域网源上禁用 `navigator.clipboard`，保留了 `execCommand` 回退）；超过 40 行的工具/终端输出折叠到「Show all N lines」之后；首个 token 落地前显示 shimmer，之后是闪烁光标。

pipeline 日志保持逐字输出（原始交错的 stdout/stderr、进度输出，不是 markdown），但同样共享粘底滚动与节点合并：同一流的连续 chunk 追加进同一个文本节点。

## 验收标准

- [x] 助手回复在流式过程中就渲染为格式化 markdown（标题、列表、表格、链接、代码围栏、引用、任务列表、删除线、水平线）
- [x] 所有渲染的 HTML 都经过 DOMPurify
- [x] 代码块有语法高亮和可用的复制按钮
- [x] 实时 turn 期间向上滚动不被打断；「跳到最新」控件出现并可用
- [x] 长 turn 不会每个 chunk 创建一个 DOM 节点
- [x] Vendor 资源位于 `public/vendor/`，不访问第三方 CDN
- [x] 保留既有行为：footer chip 条、plan/apply 流程、abort、被中断 turn 的重放/重连

## 验证

在真实浏览器中（Playwright，起本地服务）逐项验证：

- **流式 markdown**：喂入一半的文档（含未闭合围栏）→ 已渲染出 `h1`、`ul`/`ol`、任务列表 checkbox、表格、`blockquote`、`hr`，未闭合围栏渲染为 `<pre><code>`。
- **XSS**：10 个注入载荷（`<script>`、`onerror`、`javascript:` 链接与 markdown 链接、`<iframe>`、`<svg onload>`、`style` 属性、`<form><input><button>`、`formaction`、`<math xlink:href>`）全部被剥离，`__xssFired` 保持 `false`。
- **性能**：35KB / 2944 个 chunk 的回答 → 流式期间 1002 个块级节点、根下 0 个游离文本节点（旧实现会是 2944 个兄弟文本节点 + 2944 次强制重排）；500 次日志 append → 4 个 DOM 节点。
- **粘底滚动**：turn 进行中向上滚动 → `scrollTop` 保持 0、药丸出现；点击后回到底部、药丸消失、后续 chunk 继续跟随。
- **端到端**：mock SSE 驱动 Admin Terminal 和 PreIssue chat 各跑完一个完整 turn — 流式中就有 markdown，结束后高亮生效、footer chip 条正确（`⏱ 42s` / `◆ 1.23` / `Δ +3 -1`）、`Resume` 行没有泄漏进正文。
- **replay/reset**：`meta{replay:true}` 后重放整段 transcript 不会重复。

`code-review` agent 报告的两个缺陷已修复并复验：classed（stderr）日志 chunk 的节点合并失效；切换会话时被放弃的 turn 未拆除渲染器（药丸会一直挂在静态 transcript 上）。

---

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

Closes #24

## What this does

Replaces the chat UI's homegrown markdown subset (`mdToHtml()`, ~20 lines) and its "one DOM text node per SSE chunk" streaming with a **shared streaming markdown renderer**, `public/chat-render.js` (`window.CCChat`), wired into all four streaming surfaces:

- PR detail chat panel
- PreIssue chat panel
- Admin Terminal
- The pipeline log panels driven by `pumpSSE` (Create PR / Deploy / Merge)

The library stack is **vendored into `public/vendor/`** — no third-party CDN is ever hit at runtime (the app has no build step, serves `public/` statically, and is used over LAN):

| File | Library | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `marked.min.js` | marked | 15.0.7 | MIT |
| `purify.min.js` | DOMPurify | 3.2.4 | Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 |
| `highlight.min.js` | highlight.js (common languages bundle) | 11.11.1 | BSD-3-Clause |
| `highlight-github-dark.min.css` | highlight.js GitHub Dark theme | 11.11.1 | BSD-3-Clause |

## Implementation notes

**Incremental markdown while streaming.** The accumulated buffer is re-parsed on a ~60ms throttle. The source is split into top-level markdown blocks and only the blocks whose source text actually changed are rebuilt; the rest of the DOM is kept as-is. An unterminated ``` fence is closed before parsing, so code reads as code from its first line instead of snapping into a `<pre>` at the end.

**Sanitization.** Model output is untrusted, so every rendered HTML string goes through DOMPurify: scripts, inline styles, event handlers, iframes/objects/forms and `javascript:` URLs do not survive. Links are forced to `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"`. GFM task-list checkboxes are the one `<input>` allowed through, stripped down to an inert checkbox (all attributes removed, then only `type=checkbox`/`disabled`/`checked` re-added).

**Sticky-bottom autoscroll.** The view only pins to the bottom while the user is already within 40px of it; otherwise the scroll position is left alone and a "↓ Jump to latest" pill appears.

**Also.** Syntax highlighting + copy button on every code fence; a copy button on every assistant message (with an `execCommand` fallback, since Safari denies `navigator.clipboard` on plain-HTTP LAN origins); tool/terminal dumps longer than 40 lines fold behind "Show all N lines"; a shimmer before the first token lands, then a blinking caret.

Pipeline logs stay verbatim (raw interleaved stdout/stderr and progress output, not markdown) but share the sticky scrolling and node coalescing: consecutive chunks from the same stream extend a single text node.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Assistant replies render formatted markdown *as they stream* (headings, lists, tables, links, code fences, blockquotes, task lists, strikethrough, rules)
- [x] All rendered HTML passes through DOMPurify
- [x] Code blocks are syntax-highlighted and have a working copy button
- [x] Scrolling up during a live turn is not interrupted; a "Jump to latest" control appears and works
- [x] Long turns don't create one DOM node per chunk
- [x] Vendored assets live under `public/vendor/` with no third-party CDN access
- [x] Existing behaviour preserved: footer chip strip, plan/apply flow, abort, replay/reconnect of interrupted turns

## Verification

Exercised in a real browser (Playwright, against a local server):

- **Streaming markdown**: fed half a document (with an unterminated fence) — `h1`, `ul`/`ol`, task-list checkboxes, table, `blockquote` and `hr` were all already rendered, and the open fence rendered as `<pre><code>`.
- **XSS**: 10 payloads (`<script>`, `onerror`, `javascript:` links both raw and markdown, `<iframe>`, `<svg onload>`, `style` attribute, `<form><input><button>`, `formaction`, `<math xlink:href>`) were all stripped; `__xssFired` stayed `false`.
- **Performance**: a 35KB / 2944-chunk reply produced 1002 block elements during streaming and 0 stray text nodes under the root (the old path would have been 2944 sibling text nodes plus 2944 forced reflows); 500 log appends produced 4 DOM nodes.
- **Sticky scroll**: scrolling up mid-turn kept `scrollTop` at 0 and showed the pill; clicking it returned to the bottom, hid the pill, and subsequent chunks kept following.
- **End-to-end**: a full turn driven by a mocked SSE stream through both the Admin Terminal and the PreIssue chat — markdown appeared mid-stream, highlighting and the footer chip strip (`⏱ 42s` / `◆ 1.23` / `Δ +3 -1`) were correct afterwards, and the `Resume` line did not leak into the body.
- **replay/reset**: a `meta{replay:true}` re-subscribe replaying the whole transcript did not duplicate content.

Two defects reported by the `code-review` agent were fixed and re-verified: node coalescing never firing for classed (stderr) log chunks, and a turn abandoned on conversation switch never tearing its renderer down (leaving the pill stuck over a static transcript).

</details>
